entities.title: shell-tools end-to-end tests
entities.summary: cli.rs runs the built shell-tools binary as a child process and checks its arguments, stdin, exit codes, the JSONL loop and the MCP server.
entities.purpose: Checks the binary from the outside, as a shell or an MCP client sees it; the unit tests beside the code in src/ check the modules.
boundaries: Starts the binary Cargo builds for the test (CARGO_BIN_EXE_shell-tools) and writes fixtures only to temporary directories.
